name: Garlin Gilchrist
summary: Garlin Dorell Gilchrist II (born September 25, 1982) is an American politician and engineer serving as the 64th Lieutenant Governor of Michigan since 2019. A member of the Democratic Party, formerly a candidate for the Democratic nomination in the 2026 Michigan gubernatorial election, he will serve as the next Secretary of State of Michigan following the 2026 Michigan Secretary of State election.
